Your digital life, handed on properly.

Afterkeep is a free guide to what happens to your accounts, photos, passwords and crypto when you die or can't manage them, and to the tools that make sure the right person can get to them. Start with the checklist below.

Start here: 7-step checklist

  1. Move passwords into a manager with emergency access (Bitwarden)
  2. Turn on Google Inactive Account Manager
  3. Add an Apple Legacy Contact
  4. Choose a Facebook legacy contact
  5. Back up photos with Google Takeout
  6. Plan crypto inheritance
  7. Finish the full digital estate checklist

FAQ

What happens to my online accounts when I die?

Most platforms won't share your password. Some (Google, Apple, Facebook) let you name contacts in advance; others only memorialise or delete accounts on request. Setting things up ahead of time is what makes the difference.

What is the best digital legacy tool?

For most people: a password manager with emergency access (such as Bitwarden) plus free Google and Apple legacy settings.
